notes: A silent mortal is pulled into the void on the ninth MUD hour (timer > IDLE_TO_VOID 8, one check per point_update); the port uses IDLE_TO_VOID 20 and stays put. DP-1311 also covers the wall-clock reaper that voids live players after 60s and the idle timer never being reset by input (R1/R4).
Any command from a voided player returns them to their room with "$n has returned." to that room. Unobservable in the port until it voids on the same tick; the scenario's look proves C's return (R1).

At sunset C loads the moon-matched blue portal and opens one ghost-ship dock/ship exit pair; sunrise removes them. Each send_to_room message reaches only awake players in its source room. DP-1316 (R1/R3/R4).
